faqs.question: Are all study notes and PDF documents completely free to download?
faqs.answer: Yes! All revision notes, formula sheets, sample papers, and mind maps on Study Hub are 100% free to access and download for all registered students.

faqs.question: Which educational boards are covered under Class 10 & Class 12 Arts?
faqs.answer: Our notes strictly follow NCERT guidelines and cover CBSE, ICSE, and major State Boards (UP Board, Bihar Board, MP Board, Rajasthan Board, Maharashtra Board).

faqs.question: Can I watch YouTube video lectures directly on Study Hub?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can stream curated video lectures directly within Study Hub using our embedded HD media player, or click "Watch on YouTube" to open them in the official app.

faqs.question: How do I track my previous PDF downloads?
faqs.answer: When logged in, visit your User Profile or My Downloads tab to see a complete history of notes you have viewed or saved.

faqs.question: How can teachers or content creators submit notes for publishing?
faqs.answer: Teachers can submit notes by opening a Support Ticket under "Content Submission" or by registering with an Editor role via the Admin Panel.
